title: confed tree result
description: The `result` of `confed tree --json`: the space's pages as the server nests them, from the last fetch (or, with --remote, the server now). Only real pages: no other files in the workspace.

root.description: The page whose subtree this is, or null for the whole space.

depth.description: 0 for the root's children, or for top-level pages.

local.description: Whether the workspace has pulled it.

path.description: Its file, when it has been pulled.
